title: Yeasty Gooey Tunisian Mushroom Flatbread
description: A traditional Tunisian flatbread filled with sauteed mushrooms and cheese, perfect for a savory meal or snack. This dish is made with a double-rise bread and features ayurvedic-rajasic friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: active dry yeast
ingredients.notes: make sure to use fresh yeast

instructions: In a large bowl, combine yeast and warm water, letting it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
Add flour, salt, and olive oil to the bowl, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and roll out into a large circle.
In a pan, saute the mushrooms, onion, and garlic until the mushrooms release their liquid and start to brown.
Spread the mushroom mixture over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle feta cheese over the mushrooms.
Fold the edges of the dough over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Bake the flatbread for 25 minutes until golden brown.
